text:
Ian: heads-up, alerts for remote_write queue growth in us-west2 just tripped (p95 write latency 4.2s) — looks correlated with a surge of unique series from gpu-exporter pods :thinking_face:
Maria: seeing the same. Grafana TSDB intake graph shows a sharp jump in series churn around 02:13 UTC. Any recent deploys to kube-proxy / pod-label sidecar?
Olivia: we rolled a tiny kubelet relabel change last night (label sync) — suspect it's exposing container_id as a label on exporter metrics, duplicating series per restart. grabbing example logs.
PrometheusBot: alert firing: RemoteWriteQueueLength > 250 (us-west2/remotewrite-prod).
Ian: paste of tail of prometheus log: ```level=warn ts=2026-03-18T02:14:12.123Z caller=queue_manager.go:312 component=remote_write queue_length=412 remote_write=prod target=storage.googleapis.com err="write request too large, 413"```
Jamal: Also seeing lots of 429s from remote-write endpoint, backlog increases and then connection timeouts. Could be cardinality spike + batching pushing payloads over quota.
Tess: immediate mitigation — can we temporarily lower scrape_frequency for gpu-exporter & node-exporter in us-west2 to 30s -> 60s? Also mute the RemoteWriteQueueLength alert while we triage.
Maria: suggested relabel to drop the ephemeral label: in the kube service that injects labels we should drop `container_id` and `pod_uniq` from exporter metrics. Example relabel config to apply in scrape_config:
```relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_container_id]
    action: labeldrop
    regex: container_id|container\.id
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_pod_uniq]
    action: labeldrop
```
Olivia: quick check with `promtool tsdb analyze` shows series cardinality up ~18k in gpu-exporter group compared to baseline. If we keep this for hours, TSDB and long-term storage cost will jump.
Ian: another option is metric_relabel_configs to drop overly high-cardinality metrics from gpu-exporter, e.g.:
```metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [gpu_core_id]
    regex: ".+"
    action: drop
    if: "__name__=~'gpu_temp_celsius|gpu_power_watts'" # drop per-core temps for now
```
Jamal: remote_write settings we can tweak: increase timeout to 60s, enable write_splay and reduce batch_size to avoid 413s. But that slows throughput.
Tess: doing a config patch now to reduce scrape interval to 60s for gpu-exporter in us-west2 and add a short relabel to drop container_id. Will route through canary first.
Olivia: noted. Once patch is live, we should run a `curl` against prom API to check active series: `/api/v1/series?match[]=gpu_.*&start=...` and confirm drop.
PrometheusBot: deploy hook: canary applied to 3 pods in us-west2-gpu-pool at 02:20 UTC — configmap reload triggered.
Ian: after canary: queue length dropped from 412 -> 98 in ~4m. write latency p95 down to 1.1s. Good signal.
Maria: next steps: 1) Create safe relabel PR to remove ephemeral labels at source (sidecar). 2) Add metric_relabel to drop per-core temps for all gpu clusters (opt-in via feature flag). 3) Update remote_write tuning in prod override (timeout/batch_size/write_splay). 4) add an SLO and billing watcher alert tied to daily series delta so we catch this earlier.
Jamal: for audit, collecting the exact label keys causing explosion: `container_id`, `pod_ip_hash`, `pod_restart_count` — will put list in the PR.
Tess: I muted the RemoteWriteQueueLength alert for 30m during the patch and created a follow-up ticket in #incidents with runbook link.
Olivia: FYI cost estimate: if this had persisted 24h it would be ~0.9 TB extra TSDB retention => ~+$1.2k/mo ingestion/storage for that cluster. We should surface that in the postmortem.
Ian: thanks team. Once PR is merged, coordinate with deployments to revert scrape interval back and remove mute. I'll own the SLO change and dashboard panel for series delta.
Maria: +1. Also update the onboarding doc for gpu-exporter to explicitly call out allowed labels.
Jamal: will upload the label-diff script I used to detect new labels. (small python snippet + curl to /api/v1/labels).
Olivia: closing loop — queue and latency stable for 15m, unmuting alerts in 10m unless we see regression. :white_check_mark:
PrometheusBot: alert resolved: RemoteWriteQueueLength (us-west2) at 02:34 UTC.
